title: Explorer Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tuned for all-terrain exploration, the LS2 Explorer Gloss Black is purpose-built for adventure riders tackling varied weather and challenging backcountry trails across highway asphalt and backcountry gravel. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at 1460g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~90 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Long Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Value adventure helmet with peak visor and long oval fit.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for adventure riding with a slightly raised visor and integrated sun visor; fits most head shapes but may feel tight on very large heads due to the dual-sport aerodynamic profile.

technical_analysis: Features Kinetic Polymer Alloy (KPA) / HPFC High Performance Fiberglass Composite shell construction paired with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield. The interior utilizes Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the LS2 Explorer Gloss Black: combining Spain / China 🇪🇸🇨🇳 craftsmanship with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield and Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: LS2 Explorer Gloss Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the LS2 Explorer Gloss Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Long Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in LS2's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Explorer Gloss Black brings Spanish engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Long Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The LS2 Explorer Gloss Black represents LS2's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~90 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to a Long Oval head shape, the LS2 Explorer Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
